name: documenso
compareNote: ~1,200 tests, Postgres (Prisma). Already parallel: the api project runs 10 workers against one app, so isolate has little to unlock (see RESULTS.md). Long: use a subset, e.g. `just compare documenso --rounds 1 -- e2e/api/v1`
notes: Their setup (CI, .github/workflows/e2e-tests.yml): cp .env.example .env; prisma migrate + seed; `npm run ci` = turbo build of @documenso/remix, then packages/app-tests `test:e2e` = NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx' NODE_ENV=test start-server-and-test 'npm run start -w @documenso/remix' http://localhost:3000 'playwright test', with DANGEROUS_BYPASS_RATE_LIMITS=true and NEXT_PRIVATE_SIGNING_LOCAL_FILE_PATH=./example/cert.p12. The recipe reproduces that: the baseline arm is `isolate run --baseline --app` (one app, one database, their config's workers).
Their config: workers 10 overall; project api 10 ('Limited by DB connections before it gets flakey'), license 1 ('share a license file'), ui min(6, floor((cores-2)/2)).
CI sets maxFailures 1 under CI; the recipe passes --max-failures=0 and --retries=0 to both arms so every test runs once.
e2e/user/password.spec.ts hard-codes http://localhost:3000: 3 tests fail in both arms because no app runs on port 3000 here.
Mail goes to the harness's SMTP sink on 127.0.0.1:2525 (CI uses inbucket); no test reads mail.
The license project writes apps/remix/.documenso-license.json, which every app in the checkout reads (both arms).
Earlier sandbox scouting (2026-09-28): npm ci ~3 min, turbo build ~8.5 min on 4 vCPU; api project alone 15.6 min at 1 worker.
